published_ranges._drying: 150C 6-8h; keep in dry box while printing
published_ranges._notes: TDS prints nozzle '410 +/- 10'. Requires high-temperature hot end (high-flow hot end will not work) and heated chamber (e.g. Prusa Pro HT90) - beyond Bambu X1/P1 capability; no PEI system preset, bambu_parent omitted. Bed: PA Nylon sheet or powder coated with HT glue.

conflicts: Chamber: product page says 90-190 C (https://prusament.com/materials/prusament-pei-1010/); TDS says 90 C
